prompt: Create ONE square seamlessly tiling top-down albedo texture for the calm water of a premium Korean historical fantasy tower-defense game, matching a softly hand-painted sculpted animated-film environment. The water should be quiet and beautiful: muted slate blue and deep blue-green base, subtle broad cloudy blue tonal variation, a handful of softly painted narrow broken ripples in desaturated pale blue, gentle irregular currents with ample calm negative space. Lighting is diffuse cool dusk. Extremely restrained contrast, no hard specular streaks, no bright white outlines, no busy repeating pattern, no diagonal striping, no giant ocean waves, no shoreline, no land, no objects, no sky or reflection of buildings, no foam border, no caustic net, no perspective, no vignette, no text. A flat physically usable diffuse/albedo texture viewed straight down, edge-to-edge water, uniform texel scale across the whole square; all four edges must tile naturally. Avoid photographic grain, scratches, rough plastic, cellular noise, and outlined cartoon shapes. The existing approved characters will remain the visual focus; this is a softly painted supporting surface with roughly 10–15 percent luminance variation at most. Output an opaque square raster image.
processing: resize 512x512 and WebP compression only; no repainting or seam retouch
